High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard on I.A. No.4047/2025 which is first application under Section 430 of Bhartiya Nagarik
Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for suspension of remaining jail sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of
appellant Utkarsh.

02. The appellant has been convicted under Section 376(3) and 312 of Ipc and sentenced to undergo
R.I. for 20 years with fine of Rs.2,000/- and R.I. for 3 years with fine of Rs.2,000/- respectively with
default stipulation.
03.  The allegation against the appellant is that he committed a sexual assault on the prosecutrix between 15.11.2017 to 25.12.2018.
She became pregnant thereafter, he gave her some pills to get rid of it.
She disclosed this sexual assault with her brother and maternal grandmother.
Thereafter, an FIR was lodged.
At that time, she was 15 years of age.
04. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant was a student of engineering at that relevant point of time.
The FIR has been lodged because he refused the proposal of marriage given by the maternal uncle of the prosecutrix.
There is a delay in lodging the FIR.

2 CRA-3141-2022 There is no medical report about abortion, there is no DNA report and FSL report is also negative, therefore, the appellant has been convicted only on the basis of oral testimony of prosecutrix without any corroboration.

He has no criminal record, he is in jail since 09.01.2019 i.e.
more than 6 years and this is an appeal of 2022, thus, final hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future, hence, his remaining jail sentence may be suspended.
05. Learned counsel for the respondent / State opposes the aforesaid application and prays for its rejection.

sentences.text: 06. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties and also taking note of the fact that the FSL report is negative and there is no DNA report as well as there is a delay in lodging the FIR and this is an appeal of 2022, therefore, final hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future, we are of the considered opinion that the application for suspension of custodial sentence moved on behalf of the appellant deserves to be allowed.

07. Accordingly, without adverting to the merits of the case, I.A. No.4047/2025, is allowed and it is directed that subject to depositing fine amount and on furnishing personal bond by the appellant - Utkarsh in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousands Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court and on deposit of fine amount (if not already deposited), the execution of 3 CRA-3141-2022 custodial part of the jail sentence shall remain suspended, till the final disposal of this appeal.

The appellant after being enlarged on bail,
shall mark his presence before the Registry of this Court on 14.10.2025 and on all such subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Registry of this Court in this regard.
List for final hearing in due course.
Certified copy, as per rules.

(VIVEK RUSIA) (JAI KUMA  JUDGE JU  Divyansh Utkarsh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159223369/
